products.name: Intel Xeon 698X Workstation Processor
products.summary: 86-core Xeon 600 workstation flagship with up to 4.8 GHz turbo, 336 MB cache and 8-channel DDR5/MRDIMM.
products.description: The Xeon 698X heads Intel's Xeon 600 processors for workstations (Granite Rapids, Intel 3). It has 86 cores and 172 threads, a 2.0 GHz base and up to 4.8 GHz turbo, 336 MB of cache and a 350 W TDP on socket FCLGA4710, with 8 memory channels supporting DDR5-6400 and MRDIMM-8000. Intel lists a launch in Q1 2026.
products.keywords: xeon 698x xeon 600 workstation granite rapids 86 core w890

products.name: Intel Gaudi 3 AI Accelerator HL-338 PCIe Card
products.summary: Gaudi 3 inference accelerator in a 600 W, full-height dual-slot PCIe Gen5 card with 128 GB HBM2e.
products.description: The Gaudi 3 HL-338 is a full-height, dual-slot, 10.5 in PCIe 5.0 card with a 600 W card TDP. It carries 128 GB of HBM2e at 3.7 TB/s plus 96 MB of on-die SRAM, 8 MME engines and 64 Tensor Processor Cores supporting FP8, BF16, FP16, TF32 and FP32. Up to four cards can be linked with HLTB-304 top boards at 900 GB/s per card.
products.keywords: intel gaudi 3 hl-338 pcie ai accelerator inference hbm2e

specs.interconnect: PCIe 5.0 x16; RoCE v2 via HLTB-304 top board (900 GB/s)

products.notes: Intel sells Gaudi 3 through server OEMs; no list price published. Price is a TrustKart estimate.

products.name: Intel Ethernet Network Adapter E830-CQDA2
products.summary: Dual-port QSFP adapter configurable up to 200GbE on PCIe 5.0, built on the Intel E830 controller.
products.description: The E830-CQDA2 is a dual-port Intel Ethernet adapter on the E830 controller with a PCIe 5.0/4.0 host interface. Ports run at 200/100/50/25/10GbE over copper or fiber, configurable as 1x200, 2x100 (default), 4x50, 2x50 or 8x25 with breakout cables.
products.keywords: intel e830 cqda2 200gbe 100gbe qsfp nic pcie 5.0

products.name: Intel Ethernet Network Adapter E830-XXVDA2
products.priceNote: Intel ARK Recommended Customer Price. (lower bound of the $209-$216 range).
products.summary: Dual-port 25GbE SFP28 adapter on the Intel E830 controller with a PCIe 4.0 interface.
products.description: The E830-XXVDA2 is a dual-port 25/10/1GbE Intel Ethernet adapter built on the E830 controller, using a PCIe 4.0 (16 GT/s) host interface and supporting copper or fiber cabling.
products.keywords: intel e830 xxvda2 25gbe sfp28 nic homelab server

products.name: Intel Ethernet Network Adapter E610-XT2
products.priceNote: Intel ARK Recommended Customer Price. (lower bound of the $270-$281 range).
products.summary: Dual-port 10GBASE-T RJ45 adapter supporting 10/5/2.5/1GbE on the Intel E610 controller.
